policy: A team may remain operationally usable while professionally BLOCKED; BLOCKED is an acceptable audit-closure state because the Factory can no longer misrepresent it as professionally ready.

teams.name: DataScout Source-to-Marketplace
teams.genericConflation: Research/validation roles previously covered several commercial disciplines
teams.reason: Freight/import, IP/policy and category-professional review are unproven
teams.remediation: PCM per candidate; separate economics, sourcing, freight/import, policy/IP and category judgment; independent commercial sourcing Q3 before profitable/BUY-ready claims

teams.name: Zero-Cost Controlled Notification Pilot
teams.reason: Deterministic approved self-email transport contains no material professional judgment
teams.remediation: Q3 exemption applies only to fixed approved transport; generated messaging/content would require its own PCM

teams.name: Subscription Operations
teams.genericConflation: Renewal and Spend Watcher could imply finance and contract competence
teams.reason: Commercial-contract and independent professional review capability are unproven
teams.remediation: Separate subscription operations from contract interpretation; no cancel/change recommendation relying on terms without contract specialist; independent spend/renewal Q3

teams.name: Systems Intelligence & Development
teams.genericConflation: Broad systems/development title can conceal architecture, engineering and security disciplines
teams.remediation: PCM must select architecture plus stack/domain specialists; no generic systems agent may certify implementation feasibility

teams.name: Operations Core
teams.reason: Retries, dead letters, cancellation, privacy/recovery primitives are infrastructure; professional judgment belongs to consuming team
teams.remediation: Explicitly forbid Run 008 from supplying domain professional judgment; consuming job carries PCM

teams.name: Publishing/Telemetry and Municipal Intelligence surfaces
requiredDisciplines: Municipal/development research when operating that surface
teams.genericConflation: Canonical role ambiguity between publishing engine and municipal intelligence
teams.reason: Canonical role is ambiguous and municipal specialist is unproven
teams.remediation: Split deterministic publishing/telemetry service from municipal research capability; publishing service may be execution-only, municipal conclusions require PCM + domain Q3

teams.name: Vendor Invoice Overcharge Recovery
teams.genericConflation: Invoice discrepancy detection can be mistaken for professional recovery/audit judgment
teams.reason: AP audit and commercial-terms specialists are unproven
teams.remediation: Separate arithmetic anomaly detection from recoverability judgment; require AP audit Q3; legal/contract escalation for disputed terms

teams.name: Opportunity Intelligence / OUCS
teams.genericConflation: Universal opportunity analyst previously risked substituting for SaaS, trade, logistics, media, sourcing, regulatory and other professions
teams.reason: Cross-domain specialist coverage is not universally qualified
teams.remediation: OUCS owns coverage, search, decomposition, evidence packaging, routing and synthesis only; VALIDATED blocked until each gating domain specialist is qualified and independent investment Q3 passes

teams.name: Growth & Client Acquisition
teams.genericConflation: QUAL/DIAG/PROD/QA pipeline can hide multiple marketing/design disciplines
teams.reason: CRO, SEO and conversion-copy capabilities are unproven and QA is primarily brief/correctness oriented
teams.remediation: Generate PCM by deliverable; route website diagnosis to explicit CRO/UX/SEO/copy specialties; independent Q3 by relevant discipline before client-facing diagnosis or artifact

teams.name: Reserved
teams.remediation: Any future allocation must use G2.5 builder and PCM from inception

teams.name: Software Product Engineering
requiredDisciplines: Domain specialist when business rules are material
teams.genericConflation: Software product engineering can collapse multiple professions behind one delivery team
teams.reason: Most engineering/design specialists are provisional and independent professional review is not globally enforced
teams.remediation: Adopt Duka-style workstream ownership as default; PCM chooses only required disciplines; separate Q1 test QA from design/engineering/domain Q3; block release candidate status when gating professional capability is missing

teams.name: UI Excellence
requiredDisciplines: Conversion/CRO only when conversion claims are made
teams.genericConflation: UI improvement can blur UX, visual, accessibility and CRO
teams.reason: Visual/UX/accessibility capabilities remain provisional and CRO is unproven
teams.remediation: Keep visual QA independent; register UX, visual and accessibility separately; forbid conversion-performance claims without qualified CRO; calibrate reviewers before promotion

teams.name: World Technology Intelligence
teams.genericConflation: General technology analyst must not substitute for medical, battlefield, regulatory or deep technical specialties
teams.reason: Hybrid architecture and independent reviewer are good, but specialist calibration across all domains is incomplete
teams.remediation: Retain hybrid architecture; route domain-specific events to qualified specialty analysts; general analyst handles cross-domain systems only; no VERIFIED expert judgment until independent domain Q3 passes

teams.name: Alibaba to eBay Sourcing Intelligence
teams.genericConflation: Product Qualification Analyst can absorb product, competition, economics and risk judgment
teams.reason: Evidence QA is independent but commercial sourcing/import/policy professional review is incomplete
teams.remediation: Keep independent Evidence QA; add separate Commercial Sourcing Q3; freight/import and policy/IP become gating when relevant; RFQ_READY may remain evidence state but profitable/BUY-ready requires Q3

historicalRule: No historical or absent-from-canonical-registry run is treated as professionally READY merely because old artifacts exist. Reactivation requires a fresh PCM and G2.5 assessment.
